title: vinzdg/codenotch
why_read: A small practical macOS utility that surfaces usage limits from multiple AI coding tools directly on the screen edge, useful for developers juggling several AI coding subscriptions.
analysis: Codenotch is a macOS menu-bar-style app that displays usage quota information from several popular AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity in one place. This solves a real annoyance for developers who use multiple AI coding tools and want quick visibility into remaining usage without switching apps. It's a modest but genuinely useful piece of developer tooling rather than a research contribution. The technical bar is low, but practical utility for a growing class of AI-assisted-coding subscriptions gives it real value.
